title: My Bike set up 2025 Edition! My Falath Pro build out

takeaways.text: Owner build with Elves' integrated aero bar (90×400 mm), Wheeltop EDS TX shifting supplied for review, Shimano 105 crank, cassette and hydraulic calipers, 160 mm rotors and 55 mm carbon wheels; the owner wished he had chosen a longer stem.

The owner paid about £860 for the frameset including the bar (about £750–760 without it); the bottom bracket and headset bearings came with the frame. He estimated the whole bike at just under £3,000 including tools.

disclosure: The owner bought the frameset; he says the Wheeltop shifting was given to him for review, and the description has Amazon affiliate links for camera gear.
summary: Owner walk-through of a Falath Pro disc build with the Elves Orome integrated bar, Wheeltop EDS shifting, 105 hydraulic brakes and 55 mm wheels, with itemised UK costs.
